name: Streaming Sovereign Agent Identity The Case For Individual Presence In Agentic Ai Ecosyste 22557Aec60
text: Sovereign Agent Identity identifies an infrastructure asymmetry: institutions have agentic systems participating in consequential decisions, while affected individuals lack equivalent agentic presence or a way to be addressed as participants rather than subjects. This supplies an independent access problem to which Kaal's self-sovereign identity mechanism is responsive. The abstract does not show that verifiable credentials alone cure the broader imbalance.
